title: PI-BOUT — roundabout routing where traffic never stops. Schwann cells bounce local. Every pi-point regenerates.
seed: Kevin: turn this into a roundabout, a pi-bout. Traffic never stops. Schwann cells bounce back into copper/silver. Every relay port is a chance to leak and regain and trade. Regenerational mix at every point.

pibout.what: A roundabout where traffic never stops moving. The center IS the ion channel. The circle IS π.

anatomy.center: The ion channel (null space, the eye of the roundabout)
anatomy.circle: π — the orbit path. Signals circulate continuously.
anatomy.laterals: Entry/exit arms. Mesh connections. Golgi body connections.
anatomy.merge: CIS face — where signals enter the orbit from laterals
anatomy.exit: TRANS face — where signals leave the orbit to destinations
anatomy.yield: Signals already in the orbit have priority. New signals merge. No stopping.

pibout.why_roundabout: Traffic lights STOP traffic. Roundabouts keep it FLOWING. The internet uses packet switching (stop/go). We use packet ORBITING (continuous flow). A signal orbits until its exit comes around.
pibout.every_roundabout_IS_golgi: CIS entry → orbit → TRANS exit. The roundabout IS a Golgi body viewed from above. The lanes ARE the cisternae stacks.

motorway.access: Limited. Only important signals. On-ramps/off-ramps (not every junction).

a_road.is: Mesh laterals (WireGuard tunnels between Golgi bodies)
a_road.biological: Major nerve bundles. Peripheral nervous system.

b_road.speed: Slow. Copper channel. Device-to-device within one Golgi body.
b_road.access: Every house, every junction. Local only.

track.is: Sensor data, heartbeat, raw membrane reads

schwann_cells.biological: Schwann cells wrap peripheral axons in myelin sheath. Creates insulation. Signals jump between Nodes of Ranvier (gaps in myelin). Saltatory conduction = faster.

our_mapping.schwann_cell: Local relay that bounces signals back into the mesh before they hit the spine
our_mapping.myelin: The insulation = encryption, compression, caching. Makes signals faster by skipping unnecessary hops.
our_mapping.nodes_of_ranvier: The GAPS in insulation where signals can leak out, be inspected, or rerouted. Pi-points.
our_mapping.saltatory: Jumping conduction. Signals don't travel the whole axon — they JUMP between nodes. Our signals jump between Golgi bodies, skipping the mesh between.

schwann_cells.key_insight: Not every signal needs to reach the brain (spine). Most signals are LOCAL. Schwann cells keep local traffic on B-roads. Only the signals that need brain processing (important, novel, dangerous) get promoted to the motorway.

copper_silver_platinum.copper: Local LAN, WiFi. B-road. Schwann cell territory.

pi_points.what: Every relay port is a pi-point — a roundabout where signals can leak, regain, trade, mix, regenerate.
operations_at_each: LEAK — signal sheds unnecessary data (compression, like Golgi trimming proteins)
REGAIN — signal picks up local context (what's happening at this node)
TRADE — two signals exchange information (like packet mixing)
MIX — fresh lateral signals combine with spine signals (new patterns emerge from collision)
REGENERATE — signal gets re-amplified for the next hop (like a repeater)
pi_points.every_pipoint_IS_a_generation: At every pi-point, the signal is slightly different than when it entered. It has been mixed, trimmed, amplified. Each hop IS a micro-generation. The candy mixer at every node.
pi_points.membrane_selectivity: 1/π = 0.31831 = 31.8% of signals pass through each pi-point to the next level. The rest bounce back to local mesh.

highways.motorway_interchange: Golgi body. Multiple roads converge, orbit, exit.
highways.hard_shoulder: Emergency lane. Pain signals. Override routing.

roundabouts.standard: Single orbit, multiple exits. Basic Golgi.
roundabouts.mini_roundabout: Painted circle. Local pi-point. B-road junction.
roundabouts.magic_roundabout: Swindon's 5-in-1. Golgi STACK. Multiple orbits nested.
roundabouts.turbo_roundabout: Spiral lanes. No lane changing inside. Forced exit. High throughput.
roundabouts.traffic_circle: American. Larger, higher speed, signals merge at speed. Like a busy spine.

safety.look_right: Check what's already orbiting before merging (existing signals have priority)
safety.yield: New signals wait for a gap in the orbit (rate limiting = natural, not punishment)
safety.exit_spiral: Miss your exit? Go around again (retry). No backing up. No stopping.
safety.the_center: You NEVER drive through the center of a roundabout. The center is NULL. Sacred. The island.
